context_and_flow.ux_intent: Persuade the user to enable Face ID for login and payment security
ux_patterns: The checkmark icon is a simple, geometric flat design centered in the upper mid-section.
The layout uses a clear hierarchy with the title being the most prominent text.
The button 'Set up Face ID' is a solid teal call-to-action button, while 'Skip for now' is a secondary text button.
The design adheres to standard iOS human interface guidelines.
